paragraphs: Chapter 596
Episode 155. Back to Lafrarosa (4)
The protection of the cat-people. When Jin first found Lafrarosa in the past, he was able to safely pass through the beast-people's land by receiving their protection.

That protection still seemed to be effective. With just a simple disguise, he returned to the land of the beast-people, and not once were he questioned by the patrolling enemy tribes and the Baekrang tribe.

'Or is the defense network of Kinzelo's base more lax than I thought? It doesn't really matter now if my appearance entering the desert is known to the outside, but I thought Kinzelo might be a little troublesome.'
It's the closed training that Rosa sent directly. The reporters of Runcandel were already distributing articles related to Jin's closed training.
The fact that Jin was no different from being on the final path to the Throne of Swords became a major topic for the gossips.
As he passed through the Yukayuka market and arrived at the entrance to the Mitra Desert, Jin smiled at an unexpected familiar face.
[It's been a while, Jin Runcandel.]
Clean eyes like snow, white fur, mysterious purple pupils, a cat-like face.
It was the cat-person 'Neru'. The one who bestowed the cat's blessing on Jin and led him to the third tomb of Temar.
Again, the reason why Jin did not stand out in the land of the beast-people in Kinzelo's eyes was thanks to her help.
“I heard that you safely escaped from the ghostly army in the Wantaramo forest thanks to Lulu and Miru. Finally, the day has come when I can meet you in person and express my gratitude.”
[You and I are grateful to each other, so don't worry about it. It looks like you came to the desert, shall we walk together?]
Neru didn't know exactly about Lafrarosa, but she guessed that there would be a hidden path left by the solderer for Jin in the desert.
After entering the desert, he summoned Shuri.
Neru and Shuri greeted each other with a pleased "meow" sound, just like when they first met.
[It's a great blessing that Shuri met someone like you after escaping from that witch.]
[Meow!]
[Jin.]
“Yes, Neru.”
[I came to find you because there is one problem that we need to think about together.]
The area of chaos contamination.
Neru talked about it for a while.
Gliyak's chaos was not only infiltrating human society but also the world of small beast-people.

[We, the cat-people, want to participate in the purification of the contaminated area to protect the small beast-people. And the only people we can trust among humans are you and the contractor of Hister.]
According to Neru's explanation, the cat-people were able to handle the chaos in the contaminated area through their unique barrier abilities.

However, currently, because the current and previous gods of the cat-people are absent, their power is weak, so they wanted to strengthen their abilities by finding their 'Forgotten Temple' through Valeria's record magic.
Jin readily accepted Neru's proposal and pulled out paper and a pen.
"Go to Tikan and show him this letter. Valeria probably won't refuse."
[Yeah, Lulu and Miru described her as having a destiny for the world just like you.]
"Every time I hear it, it's an overpraise that makes my face hot."
Thanks to the story of the Wantaramo forest, Valeria had a good impression of the cat-people, including Lulu and Miru.
[If we can borrow the power of our gods thanks to her, we won't use it only for the small beast-people.]
Afterwards, Neru escorted Jin near the entrance of Lafrarosa while riding Shuri together.
[I'll go back now.]
"It was great to see you, please say hello to Miru and Lulu."
When Neru left, as always, the King Tantel greeted Jin.
"Brother Jin! Oh, and Shuri! It's been a while!"
[Meow!]
"Brother Tantel. How have you been?"
"What else do we do but wait for you? Oh, we also worry. If by any chance you die outside, we can't even hear the news. If you were strong enough, we wouldn't have to worry."
Jin laughed quietly.
Tantel recognized Jin's strength at once, but Jin was not yet a transcendent warrior by the King's standards.
The only group that could consider Jin as a 'promising warrior' was the King's clan.
"So this time, I'm planning to stay a bit longer for training."
"That's a good idea!"
As Tantel's sword cut through the air, a dimensional door opened to Lafrarosa.
Buildings decorated with all kinds of jewels on the golden road, and each house had a frenzied heart of dead brothers hanging in front of the gate.
Such a brilliant dead world was now Jin's second hometown. He was excited at the thought that he might be able to bring this scenery outside.
After passing the golden road, the neat stone path, and the huge stone statue commemorating the dead warriors of the King's clan, he arrived at the fighting arena.
Before opening the door, Jin touched the hearts of the King's warriors embedded in the outer wall of the fighting arena several times.
Creak-!
Boom-! Boom!
As soon as the door opened, the waiting King's brothers fired their cannons.
"Brother Jin!"
"Shuri!"
Jin couldn't help but laugh once again at the brothers' loud welcome.
Not only the 63 regular warriors excluding Tantel, but also 12 fighting kings and half of the fighting gods were waiting for Jin beyond the gate.
Jin first paid his respects to Vahn.
Vahn still exuded an unfathomable deep dignity, but Jin noticed that she had become somewhat distant since the last time they met.
'Is it because of the blood transfusion she gave me during the last training....'
Each time Vahn transfused blood, she was essentially transferring her 'Jingi' to Jin. It was like when Ron transferred Jingi to Dante at the last moment.
"I have a lot to talk about, Sister Vahn."

As soon as Shuri saw Vahn, she made a growling sound and dove into her arms. Although the figure didn't look very good because of her much larger size, she had missed Vahn's touch very much since the last time.
Shuri tended to love the touch of transcendent beings like Tesna Vahn.
"Of course. Since you'll be here for a long time, we can have a slow drink and chat today."
"Eh, fighting god brothers. How did you know that Brother Jin will stay for a long time? I was going to surprise the brothers with the news, as I was the only one who heard about it."
"It's inevitable, Brother Tantel. Brother Jin is now in a state almost equivalent to accepting his death day."
At Vahn's answer, the other King's clans' pupils grew as if they were about to pop out.
"Huh! Fighting God Brother, what do you mean!"
"Brother Jin is going to die....!"
"Brother Jin, you just said you were going to stay for a long time because of training, is there actually something wrong with your body?"
It wasn't just the King's clan who were surprised.
'I thought that Sister Vahn would recognize the chaos in my body in an instant... but a deadline?'
Jin did not think his condition was exactly the same as others who were tainted with chaos, including Rosana and Kelliark.
Although the heart devil was pressing on his inner self a little bit, it was incomparable to what he experienced in Gliyak's subspace.
Of course, it could worsen someday, so he found Lafrarosa. He used the clue that the blood of the fighting gods resisted the chaos.
In other words, he was worried, but he didn't know it was this serious.
If Vahn had a chance to compare Rosana, Kelliark, and Jin.
She would have decided without hesitation that Jin was in the most serious condition.
"Shortest a month, longest two months. If Jin hadn't come to Lafrarosa, he would have turned into a monster and met his death within that time."
"...Was my condition really that serious?"
Heavenly luck.
It was truly a stroke of luck that Jin had sought out Lafrarosa at this point, unaware of his own condition.

If the search for Qwaul had been delayed even slightly, or if Rosa had changed her mind and obstructed Jin's departure for seclusion training, the exterior cleanup would not have ended in just a month or two.
The other royal siblings also realized there was a problem with Jin. Belliz, the King of Seven Fights, abruptly grabbed Jin's wrist, showing a startled expression.
"Oh no, these are traces of Chaos!"
"Traces of Chaos? But we're immune to Chaos, aren't we?"
"Jin's race is different from ours, twelve fight king brothers."
"Well, he did receive a blood transfusion from Fight God brother and even has a heart of light, so he should be immune, shouldn't he?"
"The form of the mark... this is... it's left by the first Chaos!"
"Damn it, right, that's the only thing we're not immune to! Why did it have to be the first Chaos? Is it still present in the outer world?"
"What on earth happened out there!? Did you meet a witch or something?"
The royal siblings shouted frantically with serious expressions.
The King of Chaos and the witch Helrum existed even in the era of the royal siblings. Back then, Helrum was only referred to as the witch without a name.
"Calm down, brothers."
When Vahn raised her hand quietly, the royal siblings bowed their heads in unison and closed their mouths.
"All these discussions only make Jin more anxious. We're not too late, so we should prepare and start the purification process."
Her voice was calm, as if it was not a big deal.
However, Jin couldn't be reassured even after seeing Vahn's attitude. It was because all the other siblings who knew the method of 'purification' continued to show a worried look.
If there was any consolation, it was the fact that the reason they were worried about Jin was not death.
"Uh... Stay strong, brother Jin."
"It will be painful, but what can we do? As a brother, as always, we have to endure..."
"Well, whatever it is, we'll help."
"Yes, yes. Regardless of Jin's state or appearance, we will always consider him as a brother."
"Even if Jin forgets us, we will not forget him. Yeah, that's it."
Jin had already endured the extreme training of the royal siblings twice.
Despite this, the royal siblings were certain that it would be hard for Jin, so he couldn't help but feel a little uneasy.
"Huh? What do you mean by 'any state, any appearance'? And I might forget you guys?"
"Well, just enjoy today. It'll be hard to feel good for a while."
Instead of answering Jin's question, the royal siblings lifted him up and moved to the banquet hall.
Vahn chuckled at Jin, who kept asking questions with a puzzled face, and the brothers who were comforting him.
Of course, Vahn was also worried about Jin. However, she simply believed that Jin would be able to handle it again this time.
